title: Meeting the Red Lines: Threshold Targeting and Minority Equity among Chinese Property Developers
question: I investigate whether developers targeted the RL1 threshold and which balance-sheet adjustments and capital terms underlie their reported compliance.
summary: The answer matters because ratio-based rules work only if reported ratios track risk. I link a test of threshold targeting to accounting counterfactuals and contract evidence.
